blocks.text: HAGONOY, Bulacan, Philippines — Church groups and residents in this flood-prone town took to the streets to question the national government’s ability to solve the perennial flooding problem amid the persistent corruption. Fr. Rodel Ponce, parish priest of the National Shrine of St. Anne in Hagonoy, joined a protest march by civic movement Tindig Hagonoy
